name: GCP Cloud Run and Serverless Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Google Cloud Platform serverless architectures. Covers Cloud Run services, jobs and Cloud Run functions (formerly Cloud Functions), App Engine workloads, and the event plumbing around them (Eventarc, Pub/Sub triggers, Cloud Scheduler, Workflows). Covers runtime service account selection and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs privilege escalation, unauthenticated invocation through run.invoker granted to allUsers, ingress and authentication settings, Identity-Aware Proxy and Cloud Armor placement, VPC connector and Direct VPC egress configuration, secret handling via Secret Manager versus environment variables, metadata server token exposure, and deployment integrity through Artifact Registry and Binary Authorization.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to GCP serverless security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands GCP serverless execution models and their security concerns
evidence: Can explain the Cloud Run request-driven execution model, revisions and traffic splitting
Understands the difference between a service's runtime service account and the deployer's identity
Knows that run.invoker granted to allUsers makes a service publicly reachable
Familiar with common serverless security risks and how they apply on GCP

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Cloud Run and function configurations and permissions under supervision
evidence: Enumerates Cloud Run services, jobs and functions with their runtime service accounts under guidance
Identifies publicly invocable services and overly permissive runtime identities using lab checklists
Reviews ingress settings, VPC connectors and secret handling under supervision
Documents serverless findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses GCP serverless architecture security and identifies exploitation paths
evidence: Independently reviews Cloud Run and Cloud Run functions for insecure configurations and injection flaws reachable through their triggers
Traces privilege escalation from a deployment permission to a higher-privileged runtime service account via iam.serviceAccounts.actAs
Assesses event source trust boundaries (Eventarc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) for trigger spoofing and unauthorised invocation
Evaluates whether a compromised container can harvest tokens from the metadata server and what those tokens reach
Assesses secret exposure through environment variables, build logs and revision history
Produces compliant serverless assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex serverless architectures; develops assessment tooling; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-service serverless workflows spanning Workflows, Eventarc and Pub/Sub
Evaluates deployment integrity controls including Binary Authorization attestations and Cloud Build provenance
Develops automated tooling for GCP serverless configuration and IAM review
Identifies novel attack chains crossing serverless, IAM and networking boundaries
Reviews serverless assessment work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab GCP serverless assessment methodology; recognised authority on serverless security
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's GCP serverless security assessment methodology
Published research on novel serverless attack techniques or control bypasses on GCP
Advises organisations on secure serverless architecture and deployment integrity strategy
Trains teams on advanced GCP serverless security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a GCP serverless application with intentional misconfigurations across Cloud Run, Eventarc triggers and runtime service accounts
Given a set of Cloud Run services and their IAM bindings, identify all privilege escalation and data exfiltration paths, including those via actAs and the metadata server

cis: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0 - Section 4 Virtual Machines and Section 1 Identity and Access Management
